title: Dangerous River
subtitle: 考点：安全提醒 / It is dangerous to swim in the river.

dialogue.t: Ben, it is hot today. Do you want to swim in the river?
No, Ben. It is dangerous to swim in the river.
It rained heavily last night. The water is deep and fast.
OK. Let's go to the swimming pool instead.

vocab: river 河 · dangerous 危险的 · heavy 大的 · close 近的 · flood 洪水 · know 知道 · before 在……之前

questions.stem: What does Ben want to do?
questions.why: Do you want to swim in the river? Yes!

options: The water is deep and fast.
questions.why: The water is deep and fast.
Let's go to the swimming pool instead.

sections.title: 二、判断正误（对选 T，错选 F）

questions.why: It is dangerous to swim in the river.
